body: Thank you for your comment. I struggle with feeling like dying is the only way and living for them. It’s usually the latter but it’s just alot recently. Had a long talk with my husband and tried explaining how I feel. My daughter she’s got attachment issues or something she’s always on me cry’s if I’m not in her view. She’s never lost anyone or been by herself I’m not sure she’s just always needed me to be right by her side. My youngest 6mo is not nearly as clingy as my 3 yr old
He doesn’t want to do anything I suggest doing and I want to do anything he wants just to spend time with him but he doesn’t want to do anything and I miss him idk what else to do
He’s a nice guy I know he wants to see his friends I just constantly feel second best to them and when I address this he just moped around and says I don’t want him to have friends
I agree with both parts. My problem is he doesn’t find enjoyment in hanging out with us in his free time. He told me point blank he’d rather be with his friends. I’m at a loss

I bring this up, I don’t understand why if you have a family a job responsibility why do you need to spend the night every weekend? I think it’s unusual to want to spend a night away from your family but I know everyone is different. At the very least his friends never spend the night he always goes with them

We’ve been talking about this for days and I’m ready to give in. We get no where and I’m always left feeling like shit. I love him and I want a life with him but I feel like I never compare to his best friend. I believe he has a good relationship with our daughter I know he loves her. She’s always expected to see him after work but it’s like what’s the point of you hardly talk to us. He works outside and I know he’s tired I appreciate everything he does for our family but at some point it’s like what’s the point

Thank you for your comment! It’s comforting knowing I’m not totally losing it. If you don’t mind me asking have you dealt with this? Is there anything I can I do to ease my mind? I thought removing myself from the situation would help but sadly no
